note: Stage 1 finished ~14:30 MT (reported by Dave; tracker delivered nothing between mile 22.4 at 12:35 and the finish). Stage 2 started 15:41 MT, set manually so the rail runs before the first on-course fix arrives.

banner.title: Rolling out on stage 2
banner.body: Stage 1 done in 5:27. Weather held him at the house through the afternoon; back on course now for the Colorado Trail. Tracking was patchy on stage 1 — the satellite messenger was mounted flat in a jersey pocket and only 39% of expected fixes got through. It has been remounted facing the sky for stage 2, so gaps should be shorter from here.
